test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"my".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In option 1 **"my"** is **possessive adjective**. It will add something to the meaning of the noun. So here in blank 1 "my" will be used before noun **"dream".**

 
 
• **For example :** I went to Bengaluru but my friend went to Delhi for a new job.
 
 
 
• In option 2 the word **"me" **is in **objective case**. So me will not be used before noun **"dream".**
 
 
• **For example :** He gave me a piece of advice which was very useful in my life.
 
 
 
• In option 3 **"mine" **is a possessive pronoun. So it will not come before the noun **"dream".**
 
 
• **For example : **No one knows that the property was mine.
 
 
 
• In option 4 **"myself"** is reflective/emphatic pronoun. It is used as both reflexive and emphatic pronoun. 
 
 
• The prisoner hanged himself. **(Reflexive Pronoun)**
 
• He himself went to school in the morning **(Emphatic Pronoun).**
 
 

Thus, the correct answer is **"option 1"**
